Why teams work with us

Software shaped around the channels, languages, and operations you already have.

01

Every channel, one system

Web, social, email, WhatsApp: customers bounce between them. We put one assistant on those channels so the answer and the handoff stay consistent.

02

Language is the product

Tone and context go into the first flow. Your market's phrasing is the brief.

03

Handoff with the thread

The assistant answers the daily questions. Anything that needs a person goes to your team with the chat intact.

04

Tied to your tools

A chat that cannot check an order or open a ticket is a brochure. We connect the conversation to the system of record.

05

One slice, then more

We start with one channel or one workflow so you can see it live. Then we expand with your team.

06

We stay

Products change. We keep tuning the assistant and the automations as yours does.
